clod.definition:
n a compact mass
n an awkward stupid person
clod.translation:
n. 土块
vt. 对...掷土块

cloddish.definition: s. heavy and dull and stupid
cloddish.translation: a. 土块一样的, 呆笨的, 土里土气的

cloddy.definition: a. Consisting of clods; full of clods.
cloddy.translation: a. 土块多的, 土块一样的, 矮而结实的

clodhopper.definition: n a thick and heavy shoe
clodhopper.translation: n. 乡下佬, 粗人, 一种大而重的鞋子

clodhoppers.definition: n. a thick and heavy shoe
clodhoppers.translation: n. <口>庄稼汉, 乡巴佬( clodhopper的复数形式 )

clodhopping.translation: a. 粗鲁的, 乡下佬似的, 呆笨的

clodpated.translation: a. 愚蠢的, 呆笨的

clodpoll.definition: n. A stupid fellow; a dolt.

clods.definition:
n. a compact mass
n. an awkward stupid person
clods.translation: n. 块( clod的复数形式 ); （尤指）土块; <非正>傻瓜; 笨蛋
